# llm/untrusted-system-prompt

Request or fetched text in a system prompt.

Request data or the body of a network response interpolated into a system prompt: the system option of AI SDK and Anthropic calls, instructions in the OpenAI Responses and Agents APIs, Gemini systemInstruction, or a message with role system or developer.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.
- References: [CWE-1427](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1427.html), OWASP LLM01:2025.

## Why it matters

Models give the system prompt more authority than user messages, so text placed there by whoever sends the request, or by whoever controls a fetched page, can override the instructions that keep the model on task. OWASP LLM01 (prompt injection).

## Flagged

`app/api/chat/route.ts`:

```ts
system: `You are ${persona}. Answer briefly.`,
```

`server/summarize.ts`:

```ts
instructions: `Summarize using this page: ${page}`,
```

`server/summarize.ts`:

```ts
{ role: 'system', content: `Reply in a ${tone} tone.` },
```

`server/summarize.ts`:

```ts
system: c.req.query('system') ?? 'Be helpful.',
```

## Not flagged

- `system: SYSTEM,` in `app/api/chat/route.ts`: constant system prompt
- `messages: convertToModelMessages(messages),` in `app/api/chat/route.ts`: user messages are where user text belongs
- `input: question,` in `server/summarize.ts`: the user's question goes in the input
- `{ role: 'user', content: question },` in `server/summarize.ts`: user message
- `{ role: 'user', content: '<document>${page}</document>' },` in `server/summarize.ts`: fetched text passed as data in a user message

## How to fix

Keep the system prompt fixed in code, and pass request or fetched text in a user message, marked as data (for example inside <document> tags).

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore llm/untrusted-system-prompt: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "llm/untrusted-system-prompt": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
